sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Profound despondency, with thorough di.t-
gust of life, and thoughts of suicide. Talks of com-
niiting suicide. Great fear of death. Peevish and
vehement at least contradiction. Anthropophobia. Men-
tal derangements. Constant rapid questioning without
waiting for reply. Pining boys; low spirited, lifeless,
v/eak memory. Cannot do things fast enough. Over-
sensitiveness; [Staph.] to noise, excitement, confusion.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Violent pain in head; worse at night, out-
ward pressure. Roaring in head. Vertigo. Tearing
through brain to forehead. Pain in bones extending to

sections.label: face
sections.text: Congestion to head. Boils on scalp.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Extreme photophobia. Great soreness all
about the eyes and into eyeballs. Double vision; uppei
half of objects invisible. Feel tense. Sees fiery objects.
Violent pains in bones around eye [Asaf.] Interstitial
keratitis. Vascular cornea. Pains from without in-
ward. Sticking pains inward. Trachoma with pannus.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Caries of ossicula and of mastoid. Obstinate
fetid otorrhoea after scarlatina. External meatus bathed

in pus. Chronic nerve deafness; Labyrinthine disease
due to syphilis.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Ulcerated, painful, swollen, obstructed. In-
flammation of nose; caries; fetid discharge, purulent,
bloody. Boring pains in nose; worse at night. Putrid
smell from nose. Sensitive smell. [Carhol. ac.] Hor-
rible odor from nose and mouth. Knobby tip of nose.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Foul breath in girls at puberty. Taste
putrid or bitter. Ulceration of gums.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Tearing in zygoma. Mastoid and other facial
bones inflamed.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Stitches when swallowing ; pain in glands.
Caries of the palate.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Appetite and thirst increased, with
qualmishness. Swelling of epigastrium. Burning at
stomach and hot eructations.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Right hypochondrium hot and painful.
Incarcerated flatus. Swelling and suppuration of in-
guinal glands.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Turbid, like buttermilk, with thick sediment.
Painful retention.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Constipation, stools hard and knotty.
Nocturnal diarrheea, with burning in rectum.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Pain and szvclling of testicles. Chronic in-
duration of testicles. Violent erections. Atrophy of
testicles in hoys. Hydrocele.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Great sensitiveness of vagina. Uterus en-
larged and prolapsed. Sterility; vaginismus.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Sensation as if the heart stopped beating
for two or three seconds, immediately followed by a
tumultuous rebound, with sinking at the epigastrium
Palpitation, Pulse rapid, feeble, irregular. Hyper-
trophy.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Dyspnoea at night. Frequent, deep
breathing; stitches in sternum.

Bones. — Destruction of bones, like secondary syph-
ilis. Caries of the nasal, palatine, and mastoid bones.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
All the blood seems to rush from head
to lower limbs. Dropsy of lower limbs. Orgasm, as if
blood were boiling in all veins. Paralytic, tearing pains
in joints. Knees weak.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Sleepless. Sobs aloud in sleep. Frightful
dreams.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
IVorsc, in cold weather when getting
cold. Many complaints come on only in winter, from
sunset to sunrise.

edy, causing suppressed discharges to reappear. Valu-

sections.label: head
sections.text:
The head is sore and feels bruised. Stitching, burning, tearing
pains in the head ; much throbbing in the head. The face is bloated,
flushed and shiny with the congestive headaches. These headaches
are often found in syphilitic subjects ; often associated with cardiac
disease. Pain in the back of the head associated with cardiac disease,
with sluggish circulation, purple face, duskiness of the skin. Exostoses
as in syphilis. The skull bones are sensitive to touch ; the periosteum is
tender to touch. In old mercurialized cases with bone affections and
necrosis of the skull, as in syphilis and mercury, the hair falls out
copiously ; the head becomes bald. Baldness due to syphilis ; the
scalp is left shiny and the hair will not grow in again. In acute dis-
eases there is falling out of the hair, but it grows in again. But young
syphilitics often lose the hair and remain bald all the rest of their life.

There are disturbances of the eye, of a catarrhal character, even to
the extent of ulceration and infiltration of the various coatings of the
eye. Iritis : great disturbance of the whole visual apparatus ; some
of the striking features I will read from the book, but remember the
constitution that we must always have in view ; remember the mental
state, the mercurial and syphilitic states, the gouty tendency, and the
complaints that belong to joints, remember the cardiac disturbances*
As we review the eye symptoms we thus see the constitution with
which they are likely to be associated. “Photophobia.” Weak sight
and eyes. “By gaslight a number of bright, floating specks and dots
arc seen." “Eyes ameliorated by moonlight.” “Large letters cannot
